newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC says to keep restructuring real estate.
newsitem.headline: NCC says to keep restructuring real estate.

text.p: Swedish construction company NCC said on Thursday it will keep reducing its real estate holdings through restructuring.
"The aim is to reduce the real estate portfolio through large structurual solutions and further concentrate the holdings," NCC chief executive Jan Sjokvist said in the company's 1996 annual report.
Creating NK Cityfastigheter, which NCC recently spun off and listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange, was part of this restructuring, he said.
NCC will also boost its reported return on its real estate operations.
"In 1996, the return before tax amounted to 5.4 percent," he said. "The aim is to increase the reported return through a number of operative and structural measures."
